Maitrīkaruṇāmuditopekṣāṇāṃ sukhaduḥkhapuṇyāpuṇyaviṣayāṇāṃ
bhāvanātaścittaprasādanam /I.33/
Maitrī-karuṇā-muditā-upekṣāṇāṃ sukha-duḥkha-puṇya-apuṇya-viṣayāṇāṃ
bhāvanātaś citta-prasādanam /I.33/

 « Cultivant [respectivement] la bienveillance, la compassion, la joie et l'équanimité
754
pour les heureux, les malheureux, les justes et les injustes, le mental s'apaise et
devient clair. »

Yasya cittasya–avasthitasya–idaṃ śāstreṇa parikarma nirdiśyate tat katham
755 / Maitrī-
karuṇā-muditā-upekṣāṇām sukha-duḥkha-puṇya-apuṇya-viṣayāṇāṃ bhāvanātaś
citta-prasādanam / Tatra
756 sarva-prāṇiṣu sukha-saṃbhoga
757-āpanneṣu maitrīṃ bhāvayet,
duḥkhiteṣu karuṇām, puṇya-āt
